contexts.en: A Knowledge Base is a structured personal repository. It stores durable notes and terminology in plain text so ideas compound over time.
contexts.zh-Hant: 知識庫是一種結構化的個人知識系統。它以純文字保存長期筆記與核心術語，讓想法能隨時間持續累積與複利。

contexts.en: An Ontology is a semantic modeling method. It defines canonical concepts, bilingual labels, and typed relationships that form the backbone of a Knowledge Graph.
contexts.zh-Hant: 本體論是一種語意建模方法。它定義標準化的核心概念、雙語名稱與具型別的關係，構成知識圖譜的語意骨幹。

contexts.en: A Knowledge Graph is a network architecture. It compiles notes and Ontology concepts into an interactive web of typed relationships for visual exploration.
contexts.zh-Hant: 知識圖譜是一種網絡架構。它會自動把筆記與本體論概念編譯成具方向性與類型的互動式關聯網，方便全局探索。

contexts.en: An Evergreen Note is a note-taking principle. It encourages atomic, concept-oriented notes that evolve continuously rather than going stale after capture.
contexts.zh-Hant: 常青筆記是一種筆記原則。它強調以概念為單位撰寫清晰、可連結的筆記，並隨新理解持續迭代，而非記完就過時。

contexts.en: A Fleeting Note is a quick, temporary capture of a thought or quote. It serves as raw material to be refined into an Evergreen Note or discarded.
contexts.zh-Hant: 閃念筆記是快速隨手記下的暫存靈感或摘錄。它作為原始素材存在，之後會被提煉成常青筆記或整理歸檔。
